content.blurb: A bounded inbound definition maps selected source columns to a canonical Records contract and exposes an approved current review.

body.react: <DataExchangeAuthoringEditor value={draft} catalogue={catalogue} run={currentRun} canCommit onChange={()=>undefined} onDiscoverSource={()=>undefined} onDryRun={()=>undefined} onCommit={()=>undefined}/>

body.react: <DataExchangeAuthoringEditor value={draft} catalogue={catalogue} run={staleRun} canCommit onChange={()=>undefined} onDiscoverSource={()=>undefined} onDryRun={()=>undefined} onCommit={()=>undefined}/>
